notes_for_editor: Very thin sources. The tnlandforms list (cite 1) gives name, county, elevation and code; the Eastern US Lookouts directory (cite 2) gives only the county and agency. Neither gives a build date, design, status or access. The Eastern US Lookouts page carries a September 2006 auction note ($600, removal within 30 days), but it sits under the MUSCOGEE heading on that page, not MOSELEY, so it is not used; a web search summary attributed it to Moseley and that attribution is wrong. The list gives no units, so the story gives no elevation. Story is about 102 words, under the 120-word floor, because the sources hold nothing more about this tower. Verification 2026-10-21: the phase-out and endangered sentences were reworded from the source's wording. Status and access need a human check (GFC Putnam County office, or recent imagery at 33.39957,-83.49183). No corrections proposed; record fields match the tnlandforms list.
